# antigravity-junction-skill-fix

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows-0078D6.svg?logo=windows)](https://www.microsoft.com/windows)
[![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-brightgreen.svg)](https://antigravity.google)
[![Awesome Antigravity Tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/Awesome-Antigravity--Tools-brightgreen?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/wllzhang/awesome-antigravity-tools)
[![PowerShell](https://img.shields.io/badge/PowerShell-5.1%20%7C%207%2B-5391FE.svg?logo=powershell)](https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell)

**antigravity-junction-skill-fix** is an open-source Antigravity plugin and standalone utility that resolves skill discovery failures on Windows when skills are mounted via NTFS Directory Junctions (`mklink /J`) or Directory Symlinks (`mklink /D`).

[中文说明 (Chinese Documentation)](README.zh-CN.md)

---

## 🔍 The Problem

Antigravity's core engine uses a Go-based Language Server (`language_server.exe`) compiled with Go 1.23+:
- On Windows without Developer Mode, skill managers (such as Skills Manager or Magpie) fall back to **NTFS Directory Junctions** (`mklink /J`) to avoid `ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD`.
- Since Go 1.23 (`GODEBUG=winsymlink=1` default), Go classifies NTFS Junctions as **`fs.ModeIrregular`** rather than `IsDir()` or `fs.ModeSymlink`. Antigravity's skill scanner silently skips them.
- Meanwhile, since Antigravity `1.5.2+`, workspace `.agents/skills.json` files are confined to the repository root and cannot point to external directories outside the workspace.

---

## 💡 The v2.1 Hybrid Solution

Version `2.1.0` builds on the **Hybrid Dual-Mode Engine** (`-Mode Auto`) with **zero-pollution externalized workspace state** so bridged project skill folders stay byte-for-byte identical to upstream:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["SessionStart Hook"] --> B{"Global or Workspace?"}
    B -->|"Global (~/.gemini/config/skills)"| C["Manifest Mode: skills.json"]
    B -->|"Workspace (.agents/skills)"| D["HardLink Mode: Real Dir + External State"]
    C --> E["SKILL.md Loaded (Zero Diff / Conflict)"]
    D --> E
```

### 1. Global Skills (`~/.gemini/config/skills/`) → Non-Destructive `Manifest` Mode
- **Zero `TARGET_CONFLICT`**: Leaves NTFS Junctions and Symlinks completely untouched on disk, staying 100% compatible with `skills-manager-cli` and other symlink managers.
- **Canonical Editing**: Generates and maintains `~/.gemini/config/skills.json` (`entries` + `include_only`) pointing directly to the resolved upstream directories, so Agents see and edit the canonical source files directly.
- **Zero-Copy Cross-Drive**: Works across different drive letters (e.g., `D:` linked to `C:`) without duplicating files.
- **Automatic v1 Migration**: Any legacy v1 `.bridge_meta.json` folders in `~/.gemini/config/skills/` are automatically restored back into directory links on first run.

### 2. Workspace Skills (`.agents/skills/`, `.gemini/skills/`) → Zero-Pollution `HardLink` Mode
- **Zero Skill-Folder Pollution**: Bridge metadata is stored in an external hidden sidecar file (`~/.gemini/config/.junction_bridge_state.json`) instead of writing `.bridge_meta.json` inside skill folders. Workspace skills remain `in_sync` in Skills Manager with no false `project_newer` diffs or `held_back_removals`.
- **Automatic Legacy Migration**: Any existing v1/v2.0 in-folder `.bridge_meta.json` files are automatically migrated into the external state store and removed from skill directories on next run.
- **No-Op Sync Idempotency**: Skips writing state when nothing changed and preserves exact `LastWriteTimeUtc` timestamps in cross-drive `Copy` fallback mode.
- **Sandbox-Safe**: Transforms workspace reparse points into real directories (`d----`) containing zero-copy NTFS hardlinks so Antigravity discovers them without violating workspace boundary rules.
- **Severed-Hardlink Self-Healing**: Detects if an editor's atomic save (`temp -> rename`) broke an NTFS hardlink and automatically heals it while preserving the newer edit.
- **Reverse Sync for New Files**: Newly created files inside a bridged skill folder are reverse-propagated to the upstream source and hardlinked instead of being pruned (`.git` and `.bridge_meta.json` are always excluded).
- **Safe Unprivileged Restore**: Restoring a bridge whose metadata recorded `SymbolicLink` automatically falls back to `mklink /J` if Developer Mode is disabled.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Option 1: Install as Antigravity Plugin (Recommended)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/wllzhang/antigravity-junction-skill-fix.git
cd antigravity-junction-skill-fix
pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```
*(Or in Windows PowerShell 5.1: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1`)*

The installer deploys the plugin to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-junction-skill-fix` and runs an initial scan. Every new Antigravity conversation (`SessionStart`) keeps both global manifests and workspace bridges up to date automatically.

---

### Option 2: Standalone CLI Usage

```powershell
# 1. Scan for directory junctions, manifest mappings, and bridged skills
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Scan

# 2. Run Auto mode (Manifest for global, HardLink for workspace/custom)
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Bridge

# 3. Explicitly choose an engine mode (-Mode Auto | Manifest | HardLink)
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Bridge -TargetDir "D:\my-skills" -Mode Manifest

# 4. Sync updates / heal hardlinks
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Sync

# 5. Revert bridges / clean managed manifest entries
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Restore

# 6. Inspect status
pwsh .\scripts\bridge.ps1 -Action Status
```

---

## 🛠️ Uninstallation

To cleanly restore all skills and remove the plugin:

```powershell
pwsh .\scripts\uninstall.ps1
```

---

## 🧪 Testing

The project includes an end-to-end test suite covering 2-tier junction chains, hardlink live sync, severed-hardlink self-healing, reverse sync, unprivileged restore fallback, and Manifest mode (`skills.json` merging & legacy v1 migration):

```powershell
pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tests\bridge.Tests.ps1
```

All tests run automatically on GitHub Actions (`windows-latest`) on both `pwsh` and Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell`).

---

latestReleaseNotes:
## What's Changed in v2.1.0

- **Zero-Pollution External State Store**: HardLink/Copy workspace bridge metadata is now stored in `~/.gemini/config/.junction_bridge_state.json` (overridable via `-StateFile` or `$env:ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE_STATE_FILE`) instead of writing `.bridge_meta.json` inside bridged skill folders. Eliminates false `project_newer` diffs and `held_back_removals` update blocks in Skills Manager.
- **Automatic Legacy Migration**: Existing in-folder `.bridge_meta.json` files are automatically migrated to the external state store and removed from skill directories on next run.
- **`.bridge_meta.json` Exclusion & Stale Entry Pruning**: Excluded `.bridge_meta.json` from all forward/reverse sync paths and pruned stale state entries when bridged directories are removed or replaced.
- **No-Op Sync Idempotency & Timestamp Preservation**: Skips rewriting state when nothing changed and preserves exact `LastWriteTimeUtc` timestamps in cross-drive `Copy` fallback mode.
- **Readable Status Output**: Reordered `Status`/`Scan` table columns (`Name, Mode, Status, LinkType, Path`) so `Status` is never clipped by long Windows paths.
- **Expanded Test Suite**: 40/40 assertions passing on both PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`) and Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`).
